summary: Lane edge beside a school lawn; houses 19 m and more away, bollard ahead.
reasons: Backs onto school lawn and trees
Narrow lane to a mapped bollard

drivers.seclusion: School lawn and trees on this side; nearest house 19 m away at the start, houses 12-18 m away further along the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow lane; a car is parked near the lane end, and a mapped bollard at 10 m may block through traffic. Room beside the lane is limited.
drivers.traffic: Very light, serves a few houses and a small car park at the end.
drivers.convention: Cars park at the lane end; 2P sign applies Mon-Fri 8 am-4 pm only.

flags: Mapped bollard 10 m along, not on the only access
Houses within about 25 m on the far side
Narrow lane, little room to pull fully off
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the east and north-east; the lawn is open to the north.

best_section.where: West edge of Campus Street where it turns, beside the school lawn and trees
